title: Hieroglyphics reported at historical UFO crashes
place_text: Roswell, New Mexico; Socorro, New Mexico; Kecksburg, Pennsylvania

tellings.quote: So like you have Lonnie Zamora in ' 64. You have you know um Roswell in 47 of course you have a lot of these rumors that you know hieroglyphics are on the I think Kexsburg in ' 65 also were hieroglyphics as well.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, lists several famous American UFO cases: the 1947 crash at Roswell, New Mexico, a 1964 sighting by a police officer, Lonnie Zamora, in Socorro, New Mexico, and a 1965 event at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania. He says there are rumours that strange symbols like hieroglyphics were seen on the objects in these cases, including Kecksburg. If true, the shared markings would tie the cases together as the work of the same makers.
